scope: Exodus 25–27, all 98 public verses. Prior revisions remain unchanged.

source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Exodus 25–27.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial assessments are separate from similarity scores. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.rationale: Retains divine speech introduction as lead-in to the contribution instructions.
verses.before: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.after: The LORD spoke to Moses:
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.rationale: Preserves contribution as divine gift and voluntary heart motivation, distinguishing contributors from collectors.
verses.before: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take for me an offering. From everyone whose heart moves him, you will take my offering.
verses.after: “Tell the Israelites to bring a contribution for me. Receive my contribution from everyone whose heart moves them to give.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take for me an offering. From everyone whose heart moves him, you shall take my offering.

verses.rationale: Keeps the three metals in order and opens the materials list across verse labels.
verses.before: And this is the offering that you will take from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.after: These are the contributions you are to receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.tsw_comparator: And this is the offering that you shall take from them: gold, silver, and bronze;

verses.rationale: Supplies yarn and hair as contextual materials while preserving all colors and fibers.
verses.before: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goats’ hair;
verses.after: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, fine linen, and goat hair;
verses.tsw_comparator: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goats’ hair;

verses.rationale: Retains red rams’ skins and unresolved tahash identification instead of choosing an unverified animal species.
verses.before: ram skins dyed red, fine leather, acacia wood;
verses.after: rams’ skins dyed red, skins of taḥash, and acacia wood;
verses.tsw_comparator: ram skins dyed red, fine leather, acacia wood;

verses.rationale: Distinguishes lighting oil from anointing oil and incense, preserving shared spice supply.
verses.before: oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
verses.after: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;
verses.tsw_comparator: oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

verses.rationale: Retains traditional onyx with mineral uncertainty noted, and both priestly objects without anticipating their detailed design.
verses.before: onyx stones and stones for setting in the ephod and in the breastpiece.
verses.after: onyx stones and stones to be set in the ephod and breastpiece.
verses.tsw_comparator: onyx stones and stones for setting in the ephod and in the breastpiece.

verses.rationale: Keeps communal makers, divine dwelling and among-the-people location rather than merely inside the structure.
verses.before: Let them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell in their midst.
verses.after: Have them make a sanctuary for me, so I may dwell among them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell in their midst.

verses.rationale: Preserves exact pattern requirement and comprehensive furnishings while unfolding the repeated object structure.
verses.before: According to all that I show you—the pattern of the dwelling and the pattern of all its furnishings—so you will make it.
verses.after: Make the tabernacle and all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.
verses.tsw_comparator: According to all that I show you—the pattern of the dwelling and the pattern of all its furnishings—so you shall make it.

verses.rationale: Keeps ark term, material and all three dimensions in ancient units.
verses.before: “They will make an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
verses.after: Have them make an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
verses.tsw_comparator: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.rationale: Preserves purity, both surfaces and surrounding molding without adding a lid design here.
verses.before: You will overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside you will overlay it, and you will make a gold molding around it.
verses.after: Overlay it with pure gold, inside and out, and make a gold molding all around it.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

verses.rationale: Chooses feet for paamot with corner alternative noted; keeps four rings and two-per-side placement.
verses.before: You will cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on the other side.
verses.after: Cast four gold rings for it and attach them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on the other side.

verses.rationale: Keeps separate wood and metal-overlay instructions for carrying poles.
verses.before: You will make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.after: Make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

verses.rationale: Makes carrying purpose and side placement clear without replacing the specified ring-and-pole arrangement.
verses.before: You will put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark with them.
verses.after: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark so it can be carried with them.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark with them.

verses.rationale: Preserves positive permanence and repeated negative instruction.
verses.before: The poles will remain in the rings of the ark; they will not be removed from it.
verses.after: The poles must remain in the ark’s rings; do not remove them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be removed from it.

verses.rationale: Retains testimony as the source’s name for the divine deposit, with explanation in vocabulary rather than replacement by a generic document.
verses.before: You will put into the ark the testimony that I will give you.
verses.after: Place inside the ark the testimony I will give you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put into the ark the testimony that I will give you.

verses.rationale: Chooses atonement cover for kapporet and retains exact material and dimensions; traditional mercy-seat rendering noted.
verses.before: “You will make a cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
verses.after: Make an atonement cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make a cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

verses.rationale: Preserves two figures, gold, hammered work and opposed ends rather than supplying a later cherub image.
verses.before: You will make two cherubim of gold. Make them of hammered work at the two ends of the cover.
verses.after: Make two gold cherubim, hammering them out at the two ends of the atonement cover.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make two cherubim of gold. Make them of hammered work at the two ends of the cover.

verses.rationale: Retains repetition of one at each end and integral construction instead of merely attaching separate figures.
verses.before: Make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end. Of one piece with the cover you will make the cherubim at its two ends.
verses.after: Make one cherub at one end and one at the other. Make the cherubim of one piece with the cover at its two ends.
verses.tsw_comparator: Make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end. Of one piece with the cover you shall make the cherubim at its two ends.

verses.rationale: Preserves upward wings, covering action, mutual facing and downward orientation to cover without reducing two directions to one.
verses.before: The cherubim will spread out their wings upward, overshadowing the cover with their wings, and their faces will be toward one another; toward the cover will the faces of the cherubim be.
verses.after: The cherubim are to spread their wings upward, sheltering the atonement cover with their wings. They are to face one another, with their faces turned toward the cover.
verses.tsw_comparator: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, overshadowing the cover with their wings, and their faces shall be toward one another; toward the cover shall the faces of the cherubim be.

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated deposit instruction and cover-on-top relationship rather than deleting the repetition.
verses.before: You will put the cover on top of the ark, and in the ark you will put the testimony that I will give you.
verses.after: Put the atonement cover on top of the ark, and place inside the ark the testimony I will give you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put the cover on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I will give you.

verses.rationale: Retains precise meeting and speaking location plus transmission to Israel; does not turn cherubim into divine speakers.
verses.before: There I will meet with you, and from above the cover, from between the two cherubim that are upon the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you concerning all that I command you for the children of Israel.
verses.after: I will meet with you there. From above the atonement cover, between the two cherubim on the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you about everything I command you for the Israelites.
verses.tsw_comparator: There I will meet with you, and from above the cover, from between the two cherubim that are upon the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you concerning all that I command you for the children of Israel.

verses.rationale: Keeps table dimensions distinct from ark while matching the measurement syntax for readable comparison.
verses.before: “You will make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
verses.after: Make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated gold overlay and molding instruction for a different object.
verses.before: You will overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
verses.after: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding all around it.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

verses.rationale: Renders misgeret as rim without specifying its debated vertical placement; retains handbreadth and second molding reference.
verses.before: You will make a rim around it, a handbreadth wide, and make a gold molding around the rim.
verses.after: Make a rim a handbreadth wide around it, and a gold molding around the rim.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make a rim around it, a handbreadth wide, and make a gold molding around the rim.

verses.rationale: Keeps four rings, corners and legs, preserving the source’s repeated four.
verses.before: You will make four rings of gold for it and put the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.
verses.after: Make four gold rings for it and attach them at the four corners by its four legs.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make four rings of gold for it and put the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.

verses.rationale: Keeps rings relative to rim and carrying function, without introducing an unstated orientation.
verses.before: The rings will be close to the rim, as holders for the poles to carry the table.
verses.after: The rings are to be beside the rim, serving as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
verses.tsw_comparator: The rings shall be close to the rim, as holders for the poles to carry the table.

verses.rationale: Retains repeated pole material, overlay and transport purpose.
verses.before: You will make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and the table will be carried with them.
verses.after: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold. Use them to carry the table.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with them.

verses.rationale: Keeps four vessel categories and attaches pouring use to pitchers and bowls; exact vessel shapes remain uncertain.
verses.before: You will make its plates, dishes, pitchers, and bowls with which drink offerings are poured. You will make them of pure gold.
verses.after: Make its dishes and ladles, and its pitchers and bowls for pouring out offerings. Make them all of pure gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make its plates, dishes, pitchers, and bowls with which drink offerings are poured. You shall make them of pure gold.

verses.rationale: Retains bread-of-Presence term, before-me repetition of presence idea, and continual placement.
verses.before: You will set the bread of the Presence on the table before me continually.
verses.after: Keep the bread of the Presence on the table before me always.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me continually.

verses.rationale: Preserves hammered construction and every named part, with buds as botanical rendering of decorative knobs.
verses.before: “You will make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand will be made of hammered work—its base and shaft, its cups, buds, and blossoms will be of one piece with it.
verses.after: Make a lampstand of pure gold, hammered out. Its base, shaft, cups, buds, and flowers must all be of one piece with it.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand shall be made of hammered work—its base and shaft, its cups, buds, and blossoms shall be of one piece with it.

verses.rationale: Keeps total six and repeated three-per-side arrangement without counting the central shaft as a branch.
verses.before: Six branches will come out from its sides, three branches of the lampstand from one side and three branches of the lampstand from the other side.
verses.after: Six branches are to extend from its sides: three from one side and three from the other.
verses.tsw_comparator: Six branches shall come out from its sides, three branches of the lampstand from one side and three branches of the lampstand from the other side.

verses.rationale: Preserves full repeated ornament description and all-six application without silently multiplying buds per cup.
verses.before: Three cups shaped like almond blossoms, with bud and blossom, will be on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, with bud and blossom, on the next branch; so for the six branches coming out from the lampstand.
verses.after: On one branch are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms, a bud, and a flower; on the next branch, three cups shaped like almond blossoms, a bud, and a flower. Make all six branches extending from the lampstand this way.
verses.tsw_comparator: Three cups shaped like almond blossoms, with bud and blossom, shall be on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, with bud and blossom, on the next branch; so for the six branches coming out from the lampstand.

verses.rationale: Distinguishes central lampstand from six branches and chooses almond shape modifying cups, retaining four and noting the compact syntax.
verses.before: On the lampstand itself will be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with its buds and blossoms.
verses.after: On the lampstand itself are to be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with its buds and flowers.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the lampstand itself shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with its buds and blossoms.

verses.rationale: Unfolds three repeated beneath-two clauses into identifiable pairs while keeping all three buds and six branches.
verses.before: A bud will be under the first pair of branches coming from it, a bud under the second pair of branches coming from it, and a bud under the third pair of branches coming from it, for the six branches coming out from the lampstand.
verses.after: Put a bud beneath the first pair of branches, a bud beneath the next pair, and a bud beneath the last pair—the six branches extending from the lampstand.
verses.tsw_comparator: A bud shall be under the first pair of branches coming from it, a bud under the second pair of branches coming from it, and a bud under the third pair of branches coming from it, for the six branches coming out from the lampstand.

verses.rationale: Preserves integral construction and emphatic one-piece material instruction.
verses.before: Their buds and branches will be of one piece with it, all of it one hammered work of pure gold.
verses.after: The buds and branches must be of one piece with it. The whole lampstand is to be a single piece of hammered pure gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: Their buds and branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one hammered work of pure gold.

verses.rationale: Keeps seven lamps distinct from six branches and preserves forward lighting direction.
verses.before: You will make its seven lamps, and its lamps will be set up so that they give light in front of it.
verses.after: Make seven lamps for it and set them up to shine on the space in front of it.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make its seven lamps, and its lamps shall be set up so that they give light in front of it.

verses.rationale: Retains both handling tools and pure gold; exact tool forms not specified beyond source categories.
verses.before: Its tongs and firepans will be of pure gold.
verses.after: Its tongs and firepans are to be pure gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its tongs and firepans shall be of pure gold.

verses.rationale: Keeps one-talent total applying to lampstand together with utensils, not an added talent for each.
verses.before: It will be made from a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.
verses.after: Use one talent of pure gold to make it and all these utensils.
verses.tsw_comparator: It shall be made from a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.

verses.rationale: Preserves closing pattern warning, shown-to-Moses agency and mountain setting.
verses.before: See that you make them according to their pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.after: See that you make them according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.”
verses.tsw_comparator: See that you make them according to their pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.

verses.rationale: Keeps ten inner curtains, all four textiles and figured cherubim, distinguishing skilled design from later embroidery terminology.
verses.before: “You will make the dwelling with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn. With cherubim, the work of a skilled designer, you will make them.
verses.after: “Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn. Work cherubim into them with a skilled design.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make the dwelling with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn. With cherubim, the work of a skilled designer, you shall make them.

verses.rationale: Preserves 28-by-4 measurement and equal-size requirement.
verses.before: The length of each curtain will be twenty-eight cubits and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains will have the same measure.
verses.after: Each curtain is to be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide. All the curtains must have the same dimensions.
verses.tsw_comparator: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains shall have the same measure.

verses.rationale: Keeps two groups of five and repeated joining rather than confusing ten curtains with ten panels per set.
verses.before: Five curtains will be joined to one another, and the other five curtains will be joined to one another.
verses.after: Join five curtains together, and join the other five together.
verses.tsw_comparator: Five curtains shall be joined to one another, and the other five curtains shall be joined to one another.

verses.rationale: Clarifies terminal curtain edges on each set while retaining loop color and repeated instruction.
verses.before: You will make loops of blue yarn on the edge of the outer curtain in the first set, and likewise on the edge of the outer curtain in the second set.
verses.after: Make blue loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set. Do the same along the edge of the end curtain in the second set.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make loops of blue yarn on the edge of the outer curtain in the first set, and likewise on the edge of the outer curtain in the second set.

verses.rationale: Preserves fifty on each adjoining edge and facing relationship required for joining.
verses.before: You will make fifty loops on the first curtain and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain in the second set, the loops opposite one another.
verses.after: Make fifty loops on the first curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so the loops face one another.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make fifty loops on the first curtain and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain in the second set, the loops opposite one another.

verses.rationale: Keeps gold clasps distinct from outer bronze clasps, exact fifty, and unity of joined fabric; full accent annotation remains hashed.
verses.before: You will make fifty clasps of gold and join the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the dwelling becomes one.
verses.after: Make fifty gold clasps and join the curtains together with them, so the tabernacle becomes one whole.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make fifty clasps of gold and join the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the dwelling becomes one.

verses.rationale: Preserves separate outer tent, goat hair and eleven rather than inner ten.
verses.before: “You will make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the dwelling; eleven curtains you will make.
verses.after: Make curtains of goat hair as a tent over the tabernacle. Make eleven curtains.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the dwelling; eleven curtains you shall make.

verses.rationale: Keeps outer 30-by-4 distinct from inner 28-by-4 and repeats eleven.
verses.before: The length of each curtain will be thirty cubits and the width of each curtain four cubits. The eleven curtains will have the same measure.
verses.after: Each curtain is to be thirty cubits long and four cubits wide. All eleven must have the same dimensions.
verses.tsw_comparator: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits and the width of each curtain four cubits. The eleven curtains shall have the same measure.

verses.rationale: Preserves unequal five/six grouping and front doubling without inventing fastening details.
verses.before: You will join five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves, and fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
verses.after: Join five curtains into one set and six into another. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall join five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves, and fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.

verses.rationale: Retains two fifty-loop edges and does not add a color where none is specified.
verses.before: You will make fifty loops on the edge of the outer curtain in the first set and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain in the second set.
verses.after: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set and fifty loops along the edge of the curtain in the second set.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the outer curtain in the first set and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain in the second set.

verses.rationale: Keeps bronze, fifty, loop connection and repeated unity statement.
verses.before: You will make fifty bronze clasps, put the clasps into the loops, and join the tent together so that it becomes one.
verses.after: Make fifty bronze clasps, insert them into the loops, and join the tent together so it becomes one whole.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make fifty bronze clasps, put the clasps into the loops, and join the tent together so that it becomes one.

verses.rationale: Preserves half-curtain rear overhang distinct from side overhang in next verse.
verses.before: The overlapping part that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that remains, will hang over the back of the dwelling.
verses.after: The extra length of the tent curtains—the remaining half-curtain—is to hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: The overlapping part that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Keeps one cubit per side, length dimension and covering purpose, not two cubits on a single side.
verses.before: The cubit on one side and the cubit on the other side that remain in the length of the tent curtains will hang over the sides of the dwelling, on this side and that side, to cover it.
verses.after: The extra cubit on each side along the length of the tent curtains is to hang down over the two sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
verses.tsw_comparator: The cubit on one side and the cubit on the other side that remain in the length of the tent curtains shall hang over the sides of the dwelling, on this side and that side, to cover it.

verses.rationale: Keeps ordered skins layers and matches unresolved tahash term to 25:5.
verses.before: You will make a covering for the tent of ram skins dyed red and a covering of fine leather above that.
verses.after: Make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, with a covering of taḥash skins on top.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make a covering for the tent of ram skins dyed red and a covering of fine leather above that.

verses.rationale: Chooses frames for qerashim while noting possible solid boards; retains upright orientation and acacia.
verses.before: “You will make upright frames of acacia wood for the dwelling.
verses.after: Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make upright frames of acacia wood for the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Keeps height-length ten and width one-and-a-half without supplying thickness.
verses.before: Ten cubits will be the length of a frame and a cubit and a half the width of each frame.
verses.after: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: Ten cubits shall be the length of a frame and a cubit and a half the width of each frame.

verses.rationale: Uses joinery term for literal hands and cautious aligned for difficult meshullavot; preserves two per frame and common design.
verses.before: Each frame will have two tenons joined to one another. Thus you will make for all the frames of the dwelling.
verses.after: Each frame is to have two tenons aligned with one another. Make all the tabernacle’s frames this way.
verses.tsw_comparator: Each frame shall have two tenons joined to one another. Thus you shall make for all the frames of the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Retains twenty and southern orientation without confusing two Hebrew directional words with two sides.
verses.before: You will make the frames for the dwelling: twenty frames for the south side.
verses.after: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make the frames for the dwelling: twenty frames for the south side.

verses.rationale: Keeps forty silver bases, twenty frames and full repeated two-per-frame explanation.
verses.before: You will make forty silver bases under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons.
verses.after: Make forty silver bases beneath the twenty frames: two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make forty silver bases under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons.

verses.rationale: Preserves opposite north side and twenty count as lead-in to its bases.
verses.before: For the second side of the dwelling, on the north side, twenty frames,
verses.after: For the tabernacle’s other side, facing north, make twenty frames,
verses.tsw_comparator: For the second side of the dwelling, on the north side, twenty frames,

verses.rationale: Keeps repeated northern base count and pairing instead of referring readers back by shorthand.
verses.before: with their forty silver bases, two bases under one frame and two bases under the next frame.
verses.after: with forty silver bases—two bases under one frame and two under the next.
verses.tsw_comparator: with their forty silver bases, two bases under one frame and two bases under the next frame.

verses.rationale: Preserves rear west orientation and six main frames before corner additions.
verses.before: For the rear of the dwelling, westward, you will make six frames.
verses.after: For the rear of the tabernacle, facing west, make six frames.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the rear of the dwelling, westward, you shall make six frames.

verses.rationale: Clarifies two additional corner frames, accounting for total eight in verse 25.
verses.before: You will make two frames for the corners of the dwelling at the rear.
verses.after: Make two more frames for the corners at the rear of the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make two frames for the corners of the dwelling at the rear.

verses.rationale: Keeps paired lower and joined upper construction plus common treatment of both corners; notes uncertain precise assembly rather than claiming a complete blueprint.
verses.before: They will be doubled below, and together they will be complete at the top to the first ring. Thus it will be for both of them; they will form the two corners.
verses.after: They are to be paired at the bottom and joined together at the top into one ring. Make both corner frames this way, one for each corner.
verses.tsw_comparator: They shall be doubled below, and together they shall be complete at the top to the first ring. Thus it shall be for both of them; they shall form the two corners.

verses.rationale: Preserves computed eight and sixteen and repeated per-frame pattern.
verses.before: There will be eight frames with their silver bases, sixteen bases: two bases under one frame and two bases under the next frame.
verses.after: There will be eight frames with sixteen silver bases, two bases under one frame and two under the next.
verses.tsw_comparator: There shall be eight frames with their silver bases, sixteen bases: two bases under one frame and two bases under the next frame.

verses.rationale: Keeps acacia and first set of five as sentence continued across label.
verses.before: “You will make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames of one side of the dwelling,
verses.after: Make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames of one side of the dwelling,

verses.rationale: Retains two further five-bar sets and west-facing rear rather than five bars total.
verses.before: five crossbars for the frames of the other side of the dwelling, and five crossbars for the frames at the rear of the dwelling, westward.
verses.after: five for the frames on the other side, and five for the frames at the rear, facing west.
verses.tsw_comparator: five crossbars for the frames of the other side of the dwelling, and five crossbars for the frames at the rear of the dwelling, westward.

verses.rationale: Preserves middle position and full span without inventing a specific drilled channel construction.
verses.before: The middle crossbar will pass through the midst of the frames from end to end.
verses.after: The middle crossbar is to run through the middle of the frames from end to end.
verses.tsw_comparator: The middle crossbar shall pass through the midst of the frames from end to end.

verses.rationale: Keeps three separate gold specifications and rings as bar holders.
verses.before: You will overlay the frames with gold and make their rings of gold as holders for the crossbars, and you will overlay the crossbars with gold.
verses.after: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings on them to hold the crossbars. Overlay the crossbars with gold too.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall overlay the frames with gold and make their rings of gold as holders for the crossbars, and you shall overlay the crossbars with gold.

verses.rationale: Retains erection command, received design and repeated mountain reference.
verses.before: You will raise up the dwelling according to its plan that you were shown on the mountain.
verses.after: Set up the tabernacle according to the design you were shown on the mountain.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall raise up the dwelling according to its plan that you were shown on the mountain.

verses.rationale: Keeps partition textiles and cherubim parallel to inner curtains while distinguishing a single partition.
verses.before: You will make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen. It will be made with cherubim, the work of a skilled designer.
verses.after: Make a curtain of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled designer.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen. It shall be made with cherubim, the work of a skilled designer.

verses.rationale: Preserves four pillars and bases with correct gold versus silver materials.
verses.before: You will hang it on four pillars of acacia wood overlaid with gold, with hooks of gold, standing on four bases of silver.
verses.after: Hang it on four acacia pillars overlaid with gold, with gold hooks, standing on four silver bases.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia wood overlaid with gold, with hooks of gold, standing on four bases of silver.

verses.rationale: Keeps clasp alignment, ark beyond partition and graded sacred-space distinction without equating all interior space.
verses.before: You will hang the veil under the clasps and bring the ark of the testimony inside the veil. The veil will separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
verses.after: Hang the curtain beneath the clasps and bring the ark of the testimony inside, behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place for you.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall hang the veil under the clasps and bring the ark of the testimony inside the veil. The veil shall separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

verses.rationale: Retains all three linked sanctuary terms and precise placement of cover and ark.
verses.before: You will put the cover upon the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
verses.after: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put the cover upon the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.

verses.rationale: Keeps outside-relative-to-inner-curtain location, opposite relationship and correct south/north furniture placement.
verses.before: “You will set the table outside the veil and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the dwelling, and you will put the table on the north side.
verses.after: Place the table outside the curtain. Put the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle, and put the table on the north side.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall set the table outside the veil and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the dwelling, and you shall put the table on the north side.

verses.rationale: Distinguishes entrance screen and embroidered work from inner cherubim curtain without adding cherubim here.
verses.before: You will make a screen for the entrance of the tent of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer.
verses.after: Make a screen for the tent’s entrance of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, worked in embroidery.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer.

verses.rationale: Keeps entrance five versus inner four, gold pillars/hooks and bronze rather than silver bases.
verses.before: You will make five pillars of acacia wood for the screen and overlay them with gold. Their hooks will be gold, and you will cast five bronze bases for them.
verses.after: Make five acacia pillars for the screen and overlay them with gold. Their hooks are to be gold; cast five bronze bases for them.”
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make five pillars of acacia wood for the screen and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be gold, and you shall cast five bronze bases for them.

verses.rationale: Retains material, 5-by-5 square and height three, distinct from interior furniture dimensions.
verses.before: “You will make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide. The altar will be square, and its height will be three cubits.
verses.after: “Make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide, forming a square, and three cubits high.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square, and its height shall be three cubits.

verses.rationale: Keeps four corners, integral horns and bronze covering without replacing horn image with abstract projections alone.
verses.before: You will make horns for it on its four corners; its horns will be of one piece with it, and you will overlay it with bronze.
verses.after: Make horns at its four corners, of one piece with the altar, and overlay it with bronze.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make horns for it on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with bronze.

verses.rationale: Preserves five tool categories and ash-removal purpose; ash includes residue of burned fat, with all bronze explicit.
verses.before: You will make its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, basins, forks, and firepans. You will make all its utensils of bronze.
verses.after: Make pots to remove its ashes, along with shovels, basins, forks, and firepans. Make all its utensils of bronze.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, basins, forks, and firepans. You shall make all its utensils of bronze.

verses.rationale: Keeps netlike structure and repeated four rings/corners, all bronze.
verses.before: You will make for it a grate, a network of bronze, and on the network you will make four bronze rings at its four corners.
verses.after: Make a bronze grating in the form of a net, with four bronze rings at its four corners.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make for it a grate, a network of bronze, and on the network you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.

verses.rationale: Retains beneath-ledge position and half-height limit without asserting a direction of extension; exact reconstruction remains uncertain.
verses.before: You will put it beneath the ledge of the altar below, so that the network reaches halfway up the altar.
verses.after: Put the grating beneath the altar’s ledge, so the net reaches the altar’s midpoint.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put it beneath the ledge of the altar below, so that the network reaches halfway up the altar.

verses.rationale: Keeps carrying poles but changes overlay to bronze as required for this object.
verses.before: You will make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.after: Make poles for the altar from acacia wood and overlay them with bronze.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

verses.rationale: Preserves two-side position during transport without adding a permanent-pole rule like the ark’s.
verses.before: Its poles will be put through the rings, and the poles will be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.
verses.after: Insert the poles into the rings so they lie along the altar’s two sides when it is carried.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its poles shall be put through the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

verses.rationale: Keeps hollow construction and mountain pattern without filling cavity with a material not stated here.
verses.before: You will make it hollow, with boards. As it was shown to you on the mountain, so they will make it.
verses.after: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall make it hollow, with boards. As it was shown to you on the mountain, so they shall make it.

verses.rationale: Keeps courtyard enclosure material, southern side and hundred-cubit length with support clause following.
verses.before: “You will make the court of the dwelling. On the south side there will be hangings for the court of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits long on one side.
verses.after: Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. Along its south side, put hangings of finely twisted linen, a hundred cubits long for that side,
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall make the court of the dwelling. On the south side there shall be hangings for the court of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits long on one side.

verses.rationale: Attaches bronze to bases while noting possible application to pillars; keeps twenty each and silver fittings.
verses.before: Its twenty pillars and their twenty bases will be bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands will be silver.
verses.after: with twenty pillars and twenty bronze bases. The pillars’ hooks and bands are to be silver.
verses.tsw_comparator: Its twenty pillars and their twenty bases shall be bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be silver.

verses.rationale: Preserves full northern repetition and qere plural pillars, whose complete written/read record remains bound.
verses.before: Likewise on the north side there will be hangings one hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands for the pillars.
verses.after: Likewise, along the north side put hangings a hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars and twenty bronze bases. The pillars’ hooks and bands are to be silver.
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise on the north side there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands for the pillars.

verses.rationale: Keeps west end width fifty and ten supports without supplying materials not restated in this verse.
verses.before: For the width of the court on the west side there will be hangings fifty cubits long, with ten pillars and ten bases.
verses.after: Across the west end of the courtyard, put hangings fifty cubits wide, with ten pillars and ten bases.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the width of the court on the west side there shall be hangings fifty cubits long, with ten pillars and ten bases.

verses.rationale: Preserves doubled east/sunrise orientation and total fifty before entrance subdivisions.
verses.before: The width of the court on the east side will be fifty cubits.
verses.after: The courtyard’s east end, facing the sunrise, is also to be fifty cubits wide.
verses.tsw_comparator: The width of the court on the east side shall be fifty cubits.

verses.rationale: Makes shoulder referent clear as side of gate while preserving fifteen and three/three.
verses.before: The hangings for one side of the entrance will be fifteen cubits, with three pillars and three bases.
verses.after: Put fifteen cubits of hangings on one side of the entrance, with three pillars and three bases,
verses.tsw_comparator: The hangings for one side of the entrance shall be fifteen cubits, with three pillars and three bases.

verses.rationale: Retains exact paired gate flank and entire annotated source record rather than compressing into symmetrical shorthand.
verses.before: For the other side there will be hangings fifteen cubits, with three pillars and three bases.
verses.after: and fifteen cubits of hangings on the other side, with three pillars and three bases.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the other side there shall be hangings fifteen cubits, with three pillars and three bases.

verses.rationale: Preserves twenty-wide gate, four/four supports and colored embroidery distinct from plain courtyard hangings.
verses.before: For the gate of the court there will be a screen twenty cubits long, of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer, with four pillars and four bases.
verses.after: For the courtyard entrance, make a screen twenty cubits wide, of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, worked in embroidery, with four pillars and four bases.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the gate of the court there shall be a screen twenty cubits long, of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer, with four pillars and four bases.

verses.rationale: Keeps comprehensive all-around fitting summary and correct metals.
verses.before: All the pillars around the court will be banded with silver. Their hooks will be silver, and their bases bronze.
verses.after: All the pillars around the courtyard are to have silver bands and silver hooks, with bronze bases.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the pillars around the court shall be banded with silver. Their hooks shall be silver, and their bases bronze.

verses.rationale: Interprets fifty-by-fifty as matching end widths, retaining overall hundred length and five height; literal expression noted.
verses.before: The length of the court will be one hundred cubits, the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, with hangings of fine twisted linen and bases of bronze.
verses.after: The courtyard is to be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide at both ends, with hangings of finely twisted linen five cubits high and bronze bases.
verses.tsw_comparator: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, with hangings of fine twisted linen and bases of bronze.

verses.rationale: Preserves three exhaustive groups and metal; does not override earlier gold furnishings with unqualified all objects claim.
verses.before: All the utensils of the dwelling used in all its service, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court, will be bronze.
verses.after: All the tabernacle’s equipment for its service, all its tent pegs, and all the courtyard’s pegs are to be bronze.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the utensils of the dwelling used in all its service, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court, shall be bronze.

verses.rationale: Keeps pure beaten olive oil and tamid rendered regularly in light of following evening-morning duty, with continual alternative noted.
verses.before: “You will command the children of Israel to bring you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to make a lamp go up continually.
verses.after: Command the Israelites to bring you pure oil from beaten olives for the light, to keep a lamp burning regularly.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall command the children of Israel to bring you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to make a lamp go up continually.

verses.rationale: Preserves named male priests, outside partition but inside tent location, evening-to-morning period and enduring communal obligation.
verses.before: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil that is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons will tend it from evening until morning before the LORD. It will be a perpetual statute throughout their generations from the children of Israel.
verses.after: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain in front of the testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend it before the LORD from evening until morning. This is a lasting ordinance for the Israelites throughout their generations.”
verses.tsw_comparator: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil that is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening until morning before the LORD. It shall be a perpetual statute throughout their generations from the children of Israel.
